scope: Theorem 5.5 of the manuscript “A Counterexample to the Infinite Matroid Packing/Covering Conjecture” (preprints/A-Counterexample-to-the-Infinite-Matroid-Packing-Covering-Conjecture-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 185 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 320eb5d308aabe2d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a matroid Q on E0 = L ˙ ∪R whose bases are precisely the family ℬ in Proposition 5.4. It is equal to its dual on the same labels, and all its bases are admissible. In particular, for every basis B, BL ∈ 𝒰 =⇒ D ∖ BR ∈ 𝒰 and ρ(BL) > ρ(D ∖ BR). (5.6) Every independent set of Q that is not a basis can be extended by any element outside it.
